# ex: selector strips redundant dereference in substitution (ex.go:629-632)
# When matched expression is *ptr and substitution uses it in selector context,
# the selector applies implicit dereference, so explicit * is stripped.
ex {
	var t T
	t.Val() -> t.v
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ v int }

func (t T) Val() int { return t.v }

func f() {
	p := &T{1}
	_ = p.Val()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@

 func f() {
 	p := &T{1}
-	_ = p.Val()
+	_ = p.v
 }
